title: JARVIS BRAIN v1 Evaluation Suite
subtitle: 108 deterministic prompts, 9 task families, shared evaluator (v1)
description: Fixed, deterministic evaluation suite for the JARVIS BRAIN v1 candidate gate. Families: conversation, math, logic, coding, knowledge, instruction_following, structured_output, tool_selection, verification. eval_suite.jsonl (sha256 62ae8523b30a2b78891e2fc4391574c22199546b33e2ad5537e107a1da90e248) is shared byte-identically by the baseline and SFT kernels; evaluator.py contains the single evaluation implementation.
